transcript: What's Chase's favourite pizza? Pup-peroni!
Why is Rubble so good at building? Because he really digs it!
Why did Marshall take a ladder to school? He wanted to go to high school!
Why does Skye love school? Because she always gets high marks!
Why does Rocky never throw a joke away? Because he recycles all the best ones!
What do the Paw Patrol pups eat at the cinema? Pup-corn!
What's Zuma's favourite letter? C! Because he loves the sea!
Why do the pups never play hide and seek with Chase? Because he's always on the case!
Why don't eggs tell each other jokes? They'd crack up!
What do you call a sleeping bull? A bulldozer!
Why did the teddy bear say no to pudding? Because she was stuffed!
What's orange and sounds like a parrot? A carrot!
Why was the little biscuit sad? Because its mum had been a wafer so long!
What did the sea say to the beach? Nothing. It just waved!
What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear!
What do you call a pig that does karate? A pork chop!
What's a cat's favourite colour? Purr-ple!
Knock knock! Who's there? Lettuce. Lettuce who? Lettuce in, it's freezing out here!
What do you call a snowman in the summer? A puddle!
How does the moon cut its hair? Eclipse it!
